text: We are a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization with a mission to increase and enrich arts access in the Greater Houston area. We own and operate a 16,000+ capacity concert amphitheater where we host a diverse set of 70+ performances each year, including free arts performances and world-class touring acts. Profit made from our biggest shows allows us to support a growing number of arts programs, including grants for arts educators, scholarships for arts students and arts education activities both on and off-site.

text: Our website serves a wide variety of audiences, which makes structuring it an interesting challenge. The bulk of website visitors arrive at our site either looking to buy tickets to a concert or searching for information about our rules, parking or show schedules. However, the site must also help introduce those people to the non-profit side of our operation and provide the infrastructure necessary to facilitate the activities of our mission.

text: We are looking to replace our current site for the following reasons:

text: Though our last site build took place in 2020, the design already feels a bit outdated and static
section: We are looking to replace our current site for the following reasons:

text: People navigate sites differently in 2026 than they did in 2020, expecting less reading and more direct access to the answers they want
section: We are looking to replace our current site for the following reasons:

text: Our site is currently built to get people to read information, not to prioritize the key outcomes that matter to us organizationally
section: We are looking to replace our current site for the following reasons:

text: Though we tried to prioritize our missional efforts in the last build, we are still finding that many people don’t know about our non-profit side
section: We are looking to replace our current site for the following reasons:

text: Visual overhaul to align with current branding standards
Increase ease of use in finding specific information by simplifying structure
Maximize service to all of our audiences cohesively
Create landing pages that convert for a large number of possible outcomes
Provide some flexibility within site structure to create one-off “experience” pages for special events like a fundraising Gala
Ease of content updates – we make updates 3-5 times a day
Reduced number of “Contact Us” requests because info is easy to find
Increased engagement – longer times spent on page, more clicks to outcomes
Site works and converts excellently on desktop and mobile
Pop Over CTA (for email join, contact us)
+ backlog of hundreds of previous event pages
Responsive and meets modern accessibility standards
Backend of the site must be accessible to our team
High priority that we do not often have to come back to site builder for content updates, new templates, etc.
Integration with Ticketmaster for Season Seat holders
Easy to host video on website
Content will be provided by our team and ported by our team. We are looking to reduce cost here and want to control the content porting process.
